title: Nuclide Table (Build a Nucleus data asset)
description: Nuclide stability / half-life / decay-mode lookup data ported from PhET shred (Relational ENSDF, 2022) plus element symbols and English names from shred AtomNameUtils. Generated by scripts/extract_nuclide_data.mjs; do not hand-edit.

elements.description: Index = atomic number Z. Entry 0 is the 'no element' placeholder (empty symbol/name).

name.description: Capitalized English element name; '' for z = 0. Localization is handled outside this table.

stableNeutrons.description: Array index = proton number Z; each entry lists the neutron numbers N of stable isotopes (shred stableElementTable).

halfLives.description: Half-life in seconds. Key 'Z' -> key 'N' -> seconds; null = nuclide exists but half-life unknown; a missing key means no data for that nuclide (shred HalfLifeConstants).

decays.description: Decay modes. Key 'Z' -> key 'N' -> (ENSDF decay string -> branch percent) or null (nuclide exists but decay modes unknown). ENSDF keys are kept raw (e.g. 'B-', 'EC+B+', 'A', 'P', '2N'); mapping to the 5 simulation decay types lives in Dart NuclideRepository, mirroring shred AtomInfoUtils.

electronCloudRadii.description: Electron cloud radius per electron count (= proton number Z for the neutral atom). Visual aid data based on experimental atomic radii, tuned by PhET (shred mapElectronCountToRadius).
